_comment: Simulated meters. Readings are generated, not measured from real panels. Ids match registerSystem on testnet.

daily._comment: The server attests every finished day it has not seen at this UTC time each day, and once at start. A failed run is tried again after retryMinutes.

model._comment: Daily sun hours = meanSunHours plus or minus spreadSunHours, picked from sha256(seed, id, day). Same inputs, same reading.
